topic: Role of solute and solvent in solutions
key_concepts: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more components.
The solute is the substance that dissolves.
The solvent is the dissolving medium.
The solvent is usually present in greater amount and the solute in smaller amount.
In a sugar solution, sugar is the solute and water is the solvent.
Seawater is a solution with water as the solvent and salts, minerals, and gases as solutes
Solutions may be solids, liquids, or gases, and solute-solvent combinations can vary in st
Substances combined to form a solution do not change into new substances.
Brine is a solution of salt as solute and water as solvent.
Dextrose or sugar solution contains sugar as solute and water as solvent.
Vinegar is a liquid-liquid solution with acetic acid as solute and water as solvent.
Carbonated drinks contain carbon dioxide as a solute dissolved in water as the solvent.
